name: gangtalk-monorepo
description: 강톡 — app(React Native) / web(Vue, 회원+관리자) / functions(Firebase) 모노레포

scripts.web:build: npm --prefix web run clean && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.web:build:admin: npm --prefix web run clean:admin && npm --prefix web run build:admin
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run web:build && firebase deploy --only hosting:prod
scripts.deploy:admin: npm run web:build:admin && firebase deploy --only hosting:admin
scripts.deploy:functions: npm --prefix functions install && firebase deploy --only functions
